Title: Public Preview: Data Factory adds SQL Managed Instance (SQL MI) support for ADF Data Flows and Synapse Data Flows

Body.Content:
The Azure Data Factory team is releasing a new data flow connector to public preview for SQL Managed Instance.  This will make it easier for you to perform direct data transformation directly against data sources in data flows from Azure Data Factory and Synapse Analytics. Connecting directly to your SQL MI databases will make it super easy to transform data and create complex ETL (extract, transform, and load) processes in the cloud.

Learn more.
